# commit in repository

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:commitInRepository`](gmeow-commitInRepository.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/commitInRepository>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The repository in which a commit occurred. Functional: a commit belongs to exactly one repository (forks are separate repositories with their own history).
